results.rationale: Results are solid: revenue rose 2%, Services grew 11%, gross margin expanded to 45.9%, and buybacks were $20.5B, offset by a 13% drop in Greater China, a 25% drop in iPad, and new regulatory and antitrust risks that could pressure App Store and search licensing revenue.

Net income fell 34% and diluted EPS fell 33% in 2023, driven by a 78% rise in credit provisions, a 134 bps jump in the net charge-off rate, and a 78 bps rise in 30+ day delinquencies, with the pending all-stock Discover deal adding integration and approval uncertainty.

Earnings fell sharply (EPS down 24%, ROE 7.5% vs. a 14-16% target, efficiency ratio up to 74.6%) and investment banking fees and backlog declined, though record AUS, a surpassed alternatives fundraising target, strong capital returns and a 14.4% CET1 ratio partly offset these.
